preconditions.description: The input must be a string.
The input string can be of any length, including empty.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'In with a chance' if (phone_number.startswith('07') and len(phone_number) == 11 and phone_number[2:].isdigit()) or (phone_number.startswith('+44') and len(phone_number) == 13 and phone_number[3:].isdigit()) or (any(c.isdigit() for c in phone_number) and len(phone_number.replace('-', '')) == 11 and (phone_number.startswith('07') or phone_number.startswith('+44'))) else stdout == 'Plenty more fish in the sea'
postconditions.description: The output must be 'In with a chance' if the phone number is valid, otherwise 'Plenty more fish in the sea'.
